items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: But you played there, Diddy, huh? Yeah, I worked there.

ctx.x: Where's Billy Mac from originally? I don't know where Billy from.
But I think Billy, I think Billy and Mary McMulls was both in Mobile, if I ain't mistaken. I believe he is, from Mobile, I believe.
Well, I'll ask Punch. He worked with them for a long time.
